name: reweight misclassified examples and add a weak learner
mechanism: train a simple learner on weighted examples, increase the weights of the examples it got wrong and decrease the others, train the next learner on the reweighted set, and combine all learners by weighted vote according to their accuracy

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'AdaBoost' in section Computer science / Machine learning and statistical classification: adaptive boosting
List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'LogitBoost': logistic regression boosting

requires: a weak learner better than chance
fails_when: label noise gets ever more weight
